title: Holiness of Priests

questions.question: For whom may a priest defile himself (mourn/touch dead body)?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:2 (ESV): "Except for his closest relatives, his mother, his father, his son, his daughter, his brother..."

questions.question: What physical appearance restrictions were placed on priests?
options: Shall not make bald patches on their heads or shave off edges of beards or make cuts
questions.correctAnswer: Shall not make bald patches on their heads or shave off edges of beards or make cuts
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:5 (ESV): "They shall not make bald patches on their heads or shave off the edges of their beards or make any cuts on their body."

questions.question: What kind of woman could a priest NOT marry?
options: A prostitute or a woman who has been defiled or divorced
questions.correctAnswer: A prostitute or a woman who has been defiled or divorced
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:7 (ESV): "They shall not marry a prostitute or a woman who has been defiled, neither shall they marry a woman divorced from her husband."

questions.question: What is the punishment for a priest's daughter who plays the whore?
options: She shall be burned with fire
questions.correctAnswer: She shall be burned with fire
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:9 (ESV): "She profanes her father; she shall be burned with fire."

questions.question: Who is stricter rules applied to regarding mourning?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:10-11 (ESV): "The priest who is chief among his brothers... shall not go in to any dead bodies nor make himself unclean, even for his father or for his mother."

questions.question: Who must the high priest marry?
options: A virgin of his own people
questions.correctAnswer: A virgin of his own people
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:13-14 (ESV): "He shall take a wife in her virginity... but a virgin of his own people."

questions.question: What prevented a man of Aaron's offspring from offering the bread of his God?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:17 (ESV): "None of your offspring... who has a blemish may approach to offer the bread of his God."

questions.question: Could a priest with a blemish eat the holy bread?
options: Yes, both of the most holy and of the holy
questions.correctAnswer: Yes, both of the most holy and of the holy
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:22 (ESV): "He may eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy and of the holy."

questions.question: Why could the priest with a blemish not go through the veil to the altar?
options: That he may not profane my sanctuaries
questions.correctAnswer: That he may not profane my sanctuaries
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:23 (ESV): "But he shall not go through the veil or approach the altar, because he has a blemish, that he may not profane my sanctuaries."

questions.question: What are examples of blemishes listed?
options: Blind, lame, flat nose, broken foot, hunchback, dwarf
questions.correctAnswer: Blind, lame, flat nose, broken foot, hunchback, dwarf

questions.question: Who sanctifies the priests?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:8 (ESV): "I the Lord, who sanctify you, am holy."

questions.question: Why was the high priest strictly forbidden to leave the sanctuary (during mourning)?
options: Because the consecration of the anointing oil of his God is on him
questions.correctAnswer: Because the consecration of the anointing oil of his God is on him
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:12 (ESV): "Nor profane the sanctuary of his God, for the consecration of the anointing oil of his God is on him."

questions.question: Did the high priest mourn by uncovering his head or tearing clothes?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:10 (ESV): "Shall not let the hair of his head hang loose nor tear his clothes."

questions.question: What eye defect is specifically mentioned?
options: Blindness or a defect in his sight
questions.correctAnswer: Blindness or a defect in his sight
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:20 (ESV): "Or a defect in his sight..." (referring to a blemish).

questions.question: The priest treats the offering as "the bread of his God". What does this imply?
options: It is a sacred food offering dedicated to God
questions.correctAnswer: It is a sacred food offering dedicated to God
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:6, 8, 17 use the phrase "food (or bread) of their God" to denote the sacrifices.

key_verse_text: You shall sanctify him, for he offers the bread of your God. He shall be holy to you, for I, the Lord, who sanctify you, am holy.
